name: Bungo-ōno (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Bungo-ōno city emblem in blue and red: a blue stylised swirl like a numeral 3 with a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Bungo-ōno, a city in Ōita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 August 2005.

features.role: Bungo-ōno city emblem — a blue stylised swirl like a numeral 3 with a red disc
